pages.text: Shearing gives graded $(thing)fleece$() in the sheep's colour: a Merino's is the finest and most, a thin or sick sheep's the poorest. Spin it into $(thing)yarn$() on a $(thing)Spinning Wheel$() (sneak to felt it into wool instead), and weave four yarn into $(thing)Woollen Cloth$().

Milk is graded too, richest from a Jersey in good condition. A $(thing)Butter Churn$() turns a bucket of milk into butter at once; a $(thing)Cheese Press$() takes up to four buckets and ages them into cheese over three days. Graded produce fetches more at market.
